title: The Voices Beneath the Water

source.note: Original fan adventure requested by David for Jonathan; no source novel or real-person likeness.
source.nextStart: Episode 2: Jonathan and An enter the shared market, where Min is accused of stealing water.
source.nextEndBefore: Episode 3: the two-table negotiation between settlements.

completed.end: Jonathan escorts the child home safely. Her mother stands beside them while her voice repeats from the closed water store. Q records the sound; its cause remains unknown.

defaults.language: Short simplified Mandarin, contextual interlinear pinyin and cached audio. Screenshot membership is not reading mastery.

continuity: The child is safely reunited with her mother.
Q recorded the repeated voice from the dry water store; its source is unexplained.
Jonathan has met An; neither faction has been blamed for the phenomenon.

coverArt.prompt: Fun cinematic Star Wars adventure poster, landscape 16:9. Preserve the man on the left’s facial likeness, hair, beard and build. Cream Jedi tunic and brown robes, eager smile, single unlit lightsaber hilt. Warm gold and cool blue lighting, rocky alien planet, twin suns and stars. No woman, ice cream, text, logos or watermark.
